emailTemplates.fixedNote: These twelve emails are built in: you can change their wording, but not add or remove them.

PASSWORD_RESET.title: Password reset
PASSWORD_RESET.description: Sent when someone asks to reset their password.

EMAIL_VERIFICATION.title: Email confirmation
EMAIL_VERIFICATION.description: Sent to new portal users to confirm their email address.

GOOGLE_LINKED.title: Google sign-in added
GOOGLE_LINKED.description: Sent when Google sign-in is first added to an account that had a password.

TICKET_CREATED_CLIENT.title: Request received
TICKET_CREATED_CLIENT.description: Sent to the client who raised a new ticket.

TICKET_CREATED_TEAM.title: New ticket for a team
TICKET_CREATED_TEAM.description: Sent to the team’s email list when a ticket is routed to it.

AGENT_REPLY_CLIENT.title: Reply from support
AGENT_REPLY_CLIENT.description: Sent to the client when an agent replies publicly.

CLIENT_REPLY_ASSIGNEE.title: Client replied
CLIENT_REPLY_ASSIGNEE.description: Sent to the assigned agent (or the team list) when the client replies.

SLA_AT_RISK.title: SLA at risk
SLA_AT_RISK.description: Sent to staff when a target is about to be missed.

SLA_BREACHED.title: SLA breached
SLA_BREACHED.description: Sent to staff when a target was missed.

P1_ALERT.title: P1 alert
P1_ALERT.description: Sent to the team when a ticket becomes P1 Critical.

P1_ESCALATION.title: P1 escalation
P1_ESCALATION.description: Sent at each escalation step while nobody has acknowledged a P1.

P4_DAILY_DIGEST.title: P4 daily digest
P4_DAILY_DIGEST.description: Sent to each team’s email list once a day with its new P4 tickets.
